1417-2738-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1479-5700-5701-6664-7893.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6664-7893.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4067-5003-6797-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
4067-5003-6797-7848.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
4067-5003-6797-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

2104-2187-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Possessed Skaab.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from exile to the battlefield.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2232-7827-7830-7831.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7830-7831.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1486-4644-7223.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Stalactite Dagger on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-4644-7223.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-997-7218.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-2741-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2741-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1018-4067-6281-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1018-4067-6281-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Skullwinder.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Skullwinder that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

2478-4195-4311-4574.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
2079-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2921-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2921-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1117-2866-6518-6556.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1486-1753-4875-5475.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-4875-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
1486-1753-4875-5475.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1580-4050-4556.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {1}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

969-3259-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-5251.description:
Declare Emmara and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token with lifelink.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Soldier token, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1647-1912-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Galvanic Alchemist is paired with Codie.
1647-1912-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Codie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

2232-4050-4075.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least three.
2232-4050-4075.description:
Cast Master of Waves by paying {3}{U}.
When Master of Waves enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Master of Waves trigger, creating a number of 1/0 Elemental creature tokens equal to your devotion to blue.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing all Elemental tokens, adding that much {U}.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Master of Waves to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If your devotion to blue excluding Master of Waves is at least four, this combo will net infinite colored mana.

3590-4050-4222-4395.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real and Lightning Prowess attached to Warchanter Skald.
3590-4050-4222-4395.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
Resolve the Warchanter Skald ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dwarf Berserker, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

1271-2365-3212.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Expropriate on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Expropriate, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {5}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.

1309-1987-2510-4792.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1309-1987-2510-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.

1687-2034-3161.notablePrerequisites: You control another Human or Solider.
1687-2034-3161.description:
Cast Reins of the Vinesteed by paying {3}{G}, enchanting any Human or Soldier you control besides Siona.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature enchanted by Reins of the Vinesteed, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Reins of the Vinesteed, returning Reins of the Vinesteed to the battlefield enchanting the Human Soldier token.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
